    AI Overview

    AI Mode replied:

    Nonstop flights from Shanghai to Brussels take an average of about 12 hours and 5 minutes. You can search and compare live schedules on Google Flights. 
    Flight Details
    • Route: Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG) to Brussels Airport (BRU). 
    • Airlines with Direct Flights: Hainan Airlines and Juneyao Airlines. 
    • Average Duration: ~12 hours (nonstop); connecting flights via cities like Beijing (PEK) often take 16+ hours. 
    • Frequency: Around 5 to 6 direct flights per week, varying by season. 
    • Pricing: Round-trip economy tickets typically start around $530 to $605 depending on the season and how early you book
      .
       
    Airports
    • Departure: Shanghai Pudong (PVG) handles the nonstop departures (Terminal 2). 
    • Arrival: Brussels Airport (BRU) is located about 22 minutes (6.8 miles) from the city center.
